newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-BAYERN MUNICH CLINCH GERMAN TITLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BAYERN MUNICH CLINCH GERMAN TITLE.

text.p: Bayern Munich clinched a record 14th German championship on Saturday when they beat VfB Stuttgart 4-2 on the penultimate day of the season.

Two first-half headed goals from Christian Ziege and Mehmet Scholl and second-half strikes from Italian Ruggiero Rizzitelli and forward Marcel Witeczek secured the Bavarians an unassailable four-point lead over Bayer Leverkusen.
Leverkusen's hopes faded in a crushing 4-0 defeat at Cologne.
Bayern last won the league in 1994.
